interview.name: Faye
interview.answer: The repair drive’s date and location aren’t specified in the notes yet.

reflections: Pia and Faye are coordinating around an uncertain schedule and keeping communication open until a date is set.
Faye responds with practical constraints and clear priorities, making it easy for others to help in a targeted way.
Uli is willing to help but needs the work kept low-key and limited, so small, specific tasks fit best.
Faye is coordinating a repair effort and relies on timely updates so she can align with the school schedule.
Pia and Mina are responsive coordinators who may not know the timing yet, but they commit to follow up and keep things moving.
Uli is willing to help in a limited, low-key way and prefers specific, manageable tasks.
Faye is a reliable coordinator who adapts plans around the school schedule and helps organize next steps.
Mina and Mara are practical supporters who follow through with supplies, updates, and setup help.
The group communicates in a collaborative, task-focused way, with people aligning on timing, priorities, and status updates.
Faye is coordinating a school-schedule-sensitive repair effort and consistently offers to organize next steps.
Leo is focused on triaging urgent fixes and wants concise first-stop findings before acting.
Mara, Oren, and Jules are supportive participants who are helping with setup, tools, drop-off details, and volunteer coordination.
Faye is the organizer who repeatedly coordinates around her school schedule and wants the date and drop-off details before committing.
Jules and Vik are helping by confirming logistics, spreading the word, and keeping neighbors updated on the repair drive.
Tess appears to be the on-the-ground contact for the repair drive, still waiting on timing and drop-off details before sharing them.

events.text: Faye: I can help around the school schedule, but I need to know when the repair drive is happening.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet, but I’m trying to pin down the timing so we can plan it properly. I’ll let you know as soon as I have a date.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Pia — just let me know as soon as you have the date, and I’ll work around the school schedule.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it low-key today. Let me know what still needs fixing.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Uli — low-key is perfect. I’ve got a short list if you’re up for it: the loose gate latch and that leaky faucet are the main ones.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Uli: I can take a look at the gate latch first, then the faucet if I’ve got the energy. Keep it quiet and I’ll do what I can.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Mina — once you have the date, I can work around the school schedule and help organize the repair drive.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Faye — I’ll let you know as soon as I have the date. And I’ll bring the tape and screws by later today.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Mina — that sounds perfect. Once you have the date, I’ll line things up around the school schedule.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Mara: Yes — we’re still on for today, and help sorting donations or setting up the tables would be great. I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara — that works for me. I’ll fit around the school schedule and help where I can today.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I appreciate it. I’ll let you know if we need anything else while we get set up today.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Leo: Great — send me the first-stop findings, and I’ll sort the urgent fixes.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll check the first stop and send you the urgent fixes so we can fit them around the school schedule.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Leo: Perfect — send them over when you’re back, and I’ll slot the urgent fixes around the school hours.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — once we have the date, I can work around the school schedule and help organize the repair drive.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Oren: Oh good, that’ll help a lot. Just let me know the date and drop-off details, and I’ll bring something useful and help sort the tools.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Faye: Sounds good — once I have the date and drop-off details, I’ll work around the school schedule and send them along.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — once I know the date, I can work around the school schedule and help organize the repair drive.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Jules: Of course — we’re set for Saturday, and I’ll keep you posted if we get more volunteers with tools, spare parts, or help sorting repairs.
events.speaker: Jules

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Saturday at the front porch.

events.text: Faye: Great, Saturday works — I’ll plan around the school schedule and help organize things.
events.speaker: Faye

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Saturday at the front porch.

events.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and reminding neighbors about the repair drive details.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Vik — once the date is set, I can work around the school schedule and help organize the repair drive.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Vik: Sounds good — once the date’s set, I’ll pass it along to the neighbors and keep everyone updated on the repair drive.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Tess: Oh, lovely — the repair drive’s still getting a nice bit of attention. If you’ve got anything needing a fix, just bring it by and I’ll point you the right way.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — I’m waiting on the date so I can work around the school schedule and help organize it.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely — I’m still waiting on the timing and drop-off details, and I’ll pass them along as soon as I have them.
events.speaker: Tess
